meta_description: DJK Plumbing Preston provides emergency plumbing, repairs, and installations. Fast response, honest pricing, local family business. Call 07594 187524.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or boiler breakdown in Preston? We're out within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to new installations, we handle everything your Preston home or business needs.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages sorted fast. We carry parts on the van and aim to fix most jobs same-day without fuss.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Service
services.desc: Keep your heating running reliably. Annual servicing, fault diagnosis, and repairs — we'll get your boiler back in action quickly.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: New central heating system or upgrade your existing one. We fit modern efficient systems and guide you through the whole process.

services.title: Bathroom Fit-Outs
services.desc: Full bathroom refits from design to plumbing completion. We manage pipe runs, water supply, and drainage so everything works perfectly.

services.title: Drain Cleaning & Unblocking
services.desc: Clogged drains or sewers slowing you down? We clear blockages with modern equipment and get water flowing again the same day.

services.title: Radiator & Pipe Installation
services.desc: Add new radiators or reconfigure your heating system. Efficient pipe runs, balanced heat distribution, and neat installation throughout.

about_pullquote: We turn up when we say we will, fix it right, and charge what we quote.
about_para_1: DJK Plumbing was founded 12 years ago in Preston with one aim: to be the plumber locals actually trust. We started because too many people in the area were getting let down by unreliable firms or overcharged for straightforward work. Over a decade, we've built our reputation on showing up on time, doing the job properly, and treating every customer's home with the same care we'd show our own.
about_para_2: We're a small, hands-on team based right here in Fulwood, Preston. You always deal with someone who knows the job inside out, not a call centre. We specialise in emergency callouts — whether it's midnight on a Saturday or Bank Holiday — and we're just as committed to planned work like new boiler installations or bathroom renovations. Word-of-mouth keeps us busy, and repeat customers make up half our work.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a nightmare burst pipe on a Sunday morning. Called DJK and they were here in 40 minutes. Fixed it properly, no stress, and the price they quoted over the phone was exactly what they charged. Brilliant service. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: We'd been having trouble with our boiler cutting out. Called them mid-week and they diagnosed it straight away. Parts and labour were reasonable, and they explained what was wrong without any waffle. Been using them ever since.
reviews.author: Linda P.

reviews.text: Had our bathroom completely redone. The guys were tidy, worked around us without drama, and finished on time. Good quality work, fair pricing. Can't ask for better really.
reviews.author: James K.
